memos.skeptic:
The most likely way this loses money is a slow bleed after a dead-cat setup, not a clean rug. The coin is already down 82% from its 30-minute high and 68% over 30 minutes, with a -41% return in the last 15 minutes. Net flow over that window is -13 SOL, with 80.5 SOL sold against 67.5 SOL bought, and sellers (212) nearly matching buyers (219). That is distribution, not accumulation.

The first two minutes after graduation show 545 SOL of buying, but the sell-to-buy ratio of 0.94 and the 39% bundle share suggest that early demand was partly bundled and rotated out. The 26% completer share points the same way: buyers who carried the bonding curve to graduation are likely the ones now exiting.

At a 48.6 SOL pool and about $15.5k market cap, a $20 ticket faces a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost before any further decline. A coin already in freefall needs a sharp bounce just to break even, and the base rate for buying a dip on a coin in this state is poor. Skip.
